title: Prompt-replay skill-discovery matrix — correct skill loads by description per domain
detail: Asserts by-description loading resolves the intended skill as the top match for a representative prompt in every target domain (rust-async, rust-best-practices, playwright-cli, playwright-best-practices, webgpu/typegpu, webgpu-threejs-tsl, interviewing, authoring, dioxus, token-optimization, find-skills). Satisfies AC7 of the Agent Skill Infrastructure spec.
